nodes.label: github-and-merge.md clone/merge flow
nodes.rationale: Running the skill pipeline separately per subfolder in a monorepo would clobber a shared graphify-out/ dir, so the CLI's `graphify extract <subfolder>` is used per service (writing graphify-out/ inside each scanned path) and the resulting graph.json files are merged at the project root with `graphify merge-graphs`.
